name: Lint Python on Save
description: Run Python syntax check when bot Python files are saved

then.command: cd bot && python3 -c "import ast, pathlib, sys; errors=[]; [errors.append(f'{f}: {e}') for f in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.py') if '__pycache__' not in str(f) for e in [None] if not (lambda p: (ast.parse(p.read_text()), True)[-1])(f)]; sys.exit(1) if errors else print('All Python files OK')"
